# forward_aws_assume_role_external_id (Data Source)

Retrieve the Forward-generated external ID used by AWS assume-role cloud account collection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "forward_aws_assume_role_external_id" "current" {}

output "forward_aws_external_id" {
  value = data.forward_aws_assume_role_external_id.current.external_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) Forward network ID. Defaults to the provider network_id when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) Forward-generated AWS assume-role external ID.
